task_description: Build a one-click GPU instance booking platform with UI. Customers can request H200/B300/B200 spot instances with specific deployment plans (docker-compose topologies). The platform scans for global capacity, auto-deploys on success, provides an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with IP whitelist, sends notifications via Feishu webhook, handles same-type instance conflicts with user confirmation, and shows monitoring/history. Deployed via CDK with basic auth.

verification.summary: CDK TypeScript build passes, cdk synth produces valid CloudFormation, all 15 tests pass (including 3 new tests for EventBridge rules and instance profile), frontend builds successfully, all Python Lambda handlers pass AST validation. All 10 review issues addressed.
